source_evidence: Exact player 'we need a progressive tax system in coin, body, and blood' directs Voss to develop a progressive contribution system rather than prior flat business-levy draft. Voss proposes ONE household annual assessment on positive assessable surplus after essential living and productive expenses, with marginal House bands: first50gp0%, next100gp5%, next250gp10%, next600gp15%, excess above1000gp20%; aggregate net business income once, no double charge on same earnings. Coin or agreed equivalent goods, freely selected labor credited at actual campaign wage for skill (poor0.6gp, modest1gp, comfortable2gp, wealthy5gp, aristocratic12gp per actual workday as applicable), or genuinely voluntary informed blood contribution credited at a fair agreed value with independent healer oversight and revocable consent. No blood quota, involuntary feeding, compelled bodily service, magical coercion, punitive departure restriction or technical feeding prescription; ordinary affordable coin and labor alternatives and hardship relief preserve genuine choice. Blood credit value and arrangements remain unestablished; tower has no established vampire recipient, Caul's independent one-community trial remains separate, any involvement would require lawful voluntary terms and actual recipient arrangements. Proposed progressive assessment replaces earlier flat5% House profit levy in this draft only; proposed migration incentives including first-year relief/fair rents remain separate options. Crown taxes and rights not altered; practical tower possession is not sovereign jurisdiction over district, land title or authority to tax unrelated households. Numeric bands, assessment base, exemption scope and specific territory remain PROPOSALS pending V approval and legal authority; no actual levy enacted or collected, no appointment/wage change, new labor performed, residence, trade, funding, new agreement with Caul, title or resources. Voss asks V whether to adopt proposed marginal bands and choice-of-contribution principle. D335~15:42 western tower; provisions still zero, onward journey pending. No roll for ordinary drafting and discussion.
